overview_description.description: Forage (formerly InsideSherpa) partners with leading companies to deliver free open-access training courses for candidates. Any candidate can enroll in the company-backed courses to build career skills, visibility, and experience. The platform runs on various virtual training courses including with KPMG, Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, GE, BCG, JPMorgan Chase & Co., Citi, Deloitte, Accenture, and others. There are +1 million students in the Forage ecosystem.

about_short_description.short_description: Forage works with the world’s top employers to create job simulations for students to build career skills, visibility, and confidence.

product.name: Job Simulations
product.description: Self-paced virtual job simulations that replicate real work tasks to help students build career skills and gain insight into day-to-day roles at top companies.

product.name: Shorts
product.description: Short, under-15-minute courses that introduce different roles at top companies and provide guidance on job application strategies.

product.name: Career Interest Quizzes
product.description: Interactive quizzes that help users identify suitable career paths and roles based on their interests and preferences.

product.name: Employer Programs
product.description: Collaborations with employers to create job simulations and provide access to internships, early-career roles, and networking opportunities.

product.name: Forage consumer app
product.description: A mobile app that lets low-income families securely check EBT balances and earn rewards on everyday purchases.
